statements.JinWishart.rowAffine_det_submatrix_compl: {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b] (er ec : a ≃ b) (A B : Matrix b b ℂ) : (rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (A.submatrix er ec) (B.submatrix er ec)).det = ((Equiv.Perm.sign (ec.symm.trans er) : ℤˣ) : Polynomial ℂ) * (rowAffinePolynomialMatrix A B).det
statements.JinWishart.rowAffine_det_columnScale_com: {a : Type*} [Fintype a] [DecidableEq a] (d : a → ℂ) (A B : Matrix a a ℂ) : (rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (Matrix.of (fun i j => d j*A i j)) (Matrix.of (fun i j => d j*B i j))).det = Polynomial.C (∏ j, d j) * (rowAffinePolynomialMatrix A B).det
statements.JinWishart.rowAffine_det_realToComplex: {a : Type*} [Fintype a] [DecidableEq a] (A B : Matrix a a ℝ) : (rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix A) (Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix B)).det = ((rowAffinePolynomialMatrix A B).det).map Complex.ofRealHom
